This makes the attention/memory part of the §30 frightened/angry-person archetypes
experimentally traversable: limited selection, separate encoding and accessibility,
historical recall, and real earlier character-state feedback. It does not model a
whole frightened/angry person, and TaskConcern is not the general Affect state.

The required bounded GA obligations can close without declaring final psychological
laws. General Affect, Need, surprise, broad modalities, arbitrary role/position
inference, unguided episode segmentation and long-horizon cognition remain explicit
Campaign 3 frontiers. Other corpus members retain their previous bounded/PARTIAL/
BLOCKED dispositions; a full regression run is not a whole-corpus psychological PASS.
